Conventions for every group: the UI contract is `docs/design/ui-contract-owner-ui-on-astryx.md` ("the contract"); patterns, pitfalls (P1–P15) and assumptions (A1–A8) are in this change's `design.md`. `396800e` is the pre-change baseline commit. `pnpm test:static` and `pnpm verify:build` need no Docker, Supabase CLI or `.env.local`; only group 5 and task 13.2 need the local Supabase stack. Record every implementation fact a task asks for in `openspec/changes/owner-ui-on-astryx/implementation-notes.md` (create it with the first entry). The typecheck gate used below is `test -z "$(pnpm exec tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep 'error TS' | grep -v '^\.next/')"` (errors under the stale `.next/dev/types` are pre-existing and excluded). The diner guard must stay green after every group.
